component.name: jsonata
component.title: JSONata
component.description: Transform JSON data with a JSONata expression.
component.label: transformation

allowTemplateFromHeader.description: Whether the endpoints take the JSONata expression from the CamelJsonataResourceUri header, when the header is set, instead of from their resource. It is the default of the allowTemplateFromHeader option of each endpoint. Enable it only when the header comes from a trusted source.

contentCache.description: Whether the endpoints keep the content of their resource in memory after the first load, instead of reading it again for each exchange. It is the default of the contentCache option of each endpoint.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

frameBinding.label: advanced
frameBinding.description: A JsonataFrameBinding that binds custom functions and variables to the Jsonata.Frame of each evaluation. It is used by the endpoints that do not set their own frameBinding option.

CamelJsonataResourceUri.description: The JSONata expression to use instead of the resource of the endpoint, or the URI of a resource that holds it, with a scheme such as classpath:, file: or http:. The producer reads it only when allowTemplateFromHeader is true, and removes it from the message.

producerIn.description: JSON data: a Map, a List, a JsonNode or another object Jackson converts, or JSON as text, bytes, a stream or a file, which is parsed. Text that does not start with { or [ is read as one JSON string. With inputType=JsonString the body is always parsed as JSON

producerOut.description: The result as a Jackson 3 JsonNode, or as JSON text with outputType=JsonString

resourceUri.description: Path to the resource. You can prefix with: classpath, file, http, ref, or bean. classpath, file and http loads the resource using these protocols (classpath is default). ref will lookup the resource in the registry. bean will call a method on a bean to be used as the resource. For bean you can specify the method name after dot, eg bean:myBean.myMethod.

allowContextMapAll.description: Sets whether the context map should allow access to all details. By default only the message body and headers can be accessed. This option can be enabled for full access to the current Exchange and CamelContext. Doing so impose a potential security risk as this opens access to the full power of CamelContext API.

allowTemplateFromHeader.description: Whether the producer takes the JSONata expression from the CamelJsonataResourceUri header, when the header is set, instead of from the resourceUri option. Enable it only when the header comes from a trusted source, as its value can be any expression or the URI of any resource that Camel can read.

contentCache.description: Sets whether to use resource content cache or not

inputType.description: How the producer reads the message body as the input of the expression. With Jackson, a body that is JSON text (its first non-whitespace character is { or [), bytes, a stream or a file is parsed as JSON, other text is a JSON string value, and any other body, such as a Map or a List, is converted by Jackson. With JsonString, the body is always parsed as JSON.

outputType.description: The type of the result that the producer sets as the message body: Jackson for a Jackson 3 JsonNode, or JsonString for the JSON text.

prettyPrint.description: Whether to format the JSON text of the result with indentation and line breaks. It applies only when outputType is JsonString.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer,advanced
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

frameBinding.label: advanced
frameBinding.description: A JsonataFrameBinding that the producer calls with the Jsonata.Frame of each evaluation, to bind custom functions and variables that the expression can use. If not set, the frameBinding option of the component is used.
